idea-plugin.name: Unreal Asset Preview
idea-plugin.description: Local, read-only Unreal asset reviews: linked revision viewports, component and settings differences, Blueprint pin changes and readable explanations. Requires the companion RiderAssetPreview plugin in an open Unreal Editor project. Supports Rider's two-way Commit/Git History diffs, Actor Blueprint defaults, static meshes, skeletal meshes, Texture2D and property inspection for other assets. Dependencies come from the open project's current versions.
